references.text: Describes the actual killing of Jerubba'al's seventy sons on one stone, which Jotham refers to in verse 18
Tells how the people of Shechem made Abimelech king, for which Jotham accuses them
Provides background on Gideon's sons and Abimelech as the son of his slave woman in Shechem
Abimelech appeals to kinship with the people of Shechem through his mother, something Jotham mocks
The fulfillment of Jotham's curse - God repaid Abimelech and the men of Shechem for their evil against Jerubba'al's house
Abimelech means 'my father is king', a name also used for Philistine kings
